title: Introductory Python buggy-program problem set
summary: Learners receive introductory Python problems and incomplete or buggy programs that require repair, hints, grading feedback, peer completion, or explanation. The paper uses five problems with five buggy submissions each to compare ChatGPT, GPT-4, and human tutors rather than deploying the models to students.

sources.title: Generative AI for Programming Education: Benchmarking ChatGPT, GPT-4, and Human Tutors
sources.evidence_quote: We conduct our evaluation based on 5 introductory Python programming problems with a diverse set of input/output specifications.

assessment.summary: Repair, explain, complete, or receive feedback on buggy Python programs drawn from public introductory examples.
student_actions: Repair or complete the program and reason about its defects.

student_role.description: The study benchmarks model outputs for tutor and peer roles; it does not report student use.
